changelog: New voice command "cut last word" — say "cut last word" alone while dictating (or "শেষ শব্দ কেটে নাও") and the last word before the cursor is cut to the clipboard in one step: it leaves the message and is ready to paste anywhere. Before, you had to say "copy last word" and then "delete last word" separately. Also fixes the "cut last sentence" confirmation message showing odd characters. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
